Card Q&A.a: No. The Digimon suspended by this effect -- along with all of your opponent's other suspended Digimon -- remain suspended during their unsuspend phase.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's [On Play] effect to suspend an opponent's Digimon. Is that Digimon the only one that doesn't unsuspend during my opponent's next unsuspend phase?

Card Q&A.a: No. It only prevents suspended Digimon from unsuspending. Any unsuspended Digimon remain that way.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [On Play] effect cause my opponent's unsuspended Digimon to suspend themselves during their next unsuspend phase?

Card Q&A.a: No, the effect doesn't affect Tamers. They unsuspend as normal.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [On Play] effect prevent my opponent's suspended Tamers from unsuspending during their next unsuspend phase?

Effect: [On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. During your opponent's next unsuspend phase, none of your opponent's Digimon can unsuspend.
